Name: Maru new look (Seasonal)
Author: pinzol
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#ffff00]UPDATED FOR 1.6 + SEASONAL OUTFITS[/color][/b]
[/size]
Maru's new portraits and sprites. Always wanted to give Maru curly hair, I think it suits her really really well. I reworked this mod twice already and this last update took about 2-3 full weeks to finish. I think I did Maru justice, she deserves all the love.

[list]
[*]Now the mod has Seasonal outfits for every season (Including some outfits for indoors).
[*]Fixed a few errors with portraits, remade ALL of her sprites from scratch
[*]Added new hairstyles for some seasons to make it more interesting
[*]Added opportunity to turn glasses on and off
[*]You can turn off Maru's headphones she wears in Fall now via configuration (I personall like headphones on her, but I suppose it can be irritating)
[*]Added opportunity to use edited version of Maru's rooms (spouse room and her room at Robin's). 
[/list]
﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6375/6375-1714854768-602912408.gif[/img]﻿

[color=#ffff00][b]How to install:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Have Content patcher installed
[*]Download archive and drop the folder inside the archive into your Mods folder
[*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change [b]config.json[/b] file in the mod's folder manually.﻿
[/list][color=#ffff00]
[b]Warning:
[/b][/color]This mod can and will conflict with any other mod that changes Maru's appearance.
It might also conflict with mods that change spouse rooms or Robin's house map. Just set mod's settings for edited rooms to "false" if you do not wish to use my version of them. If you're using SVE, my Robin's house edits will turn off on their own and use SVE's version of the maps only. Spouse room edit will still work. Pay attention, guys :)

-------------------------------------------------
